page.content:
Lin Kuei cryomancer — two brothers who share the name.

How Sub-Zero connects

  • Faction: Lin Kuei — Sub-Zero is the cryomancer face of the Lin Kuei.
  • Character: Scorpion — Scorpion's vendetta is aimed at the Sub-Zero who killed him.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat (1992) — Mortal Kombat (1992) introduced Sub-Zero as the Lin Kuei ice ninja.

What is Sub-Zero?

Sub-Zero is the Lin Kuei ice warrior: first Bi-Han, who killed Scorpion and became Noob Saibot, then his brother Kuai Liang, who later led the clan away from the Cyber Lin Kuei.

Key threads lead to Lin Kuei, Scorpion and Mortal Kombat (1992).
